        self.team2 = Team('Team2', ['Eve', 'Mallory'])

        self.soccer_system.register_team(self.team1)
        self.soccer_system.register_team(self.team2)

        self.soccer_system.matches[0].set_score(0, 1)

        self.assertEqual(self.team1.points, 1)
        self.assertEqual(self.team2.points, 0)
